name: goblin-warband
description: A warband raids in good order or not at all. One chief, many sessions, one repo: orders read, dibs called, tribute paid, spoils counted. Coordinate several Claude Code sessions on one repository: a ledger of dibs on shared resources enforced by hooks, a /show-slate pane, tools that report, call dibs, grant and broadcast, a declaration that writes each raider's orders, and the protocol that came out of running it.

enabled.title: Warband on
enabled.description: The one switch for all of it. Off, nothing is registered and the command hooks still run but the slate, the tools and the dibs approval do not.

approve_in_slot.title: Approve gated commands under held dibs
approve_in_slot.description: While this session holds the dibs on a resource and runs the command from its own worktree, a project hook's ask on that command is answered allow, so the person does not type it. Only resources marked approve_in_slot in the project config; never a taboo.

refresh_seconds.title: Slate refresh
refresh_seconds.description: How often the slate rereads the ledger while open, in seconds.
